name: OpenBot
description: Open-source AI coworkers that each get a computer of their own: a browser, files and tools, with every action decided before it happens and recorded after. Bring any AG-UI agent.
one_liner: Self-hosted 'AI coworkers' — like an AI assistant that can use its own browser, files, and tools to actually do tasks for your company, with every action approved before it happens.
buyer: An operations or IT manager at a mid-size company who wants in-house AI automation without sending sensitive data to a third-party SaaS AI tool.
business_use_cases: An ops team deploys it to automate repetitive browser-based tasks (data entry, research, report generation) with human approval gates.
An IT department self-hosts it to give employees an internal AI assistant without company data leaving their own infrastructure.
A systems integrator deploys and customizes it for clients as part of an 'AI automation' consulting engagement.

money_ideas.idea: Charge for deployment, custom agent integration, and support as a consulting or implementation service
Ongoing managed-hosting and maintenance retainer for companies that don't want to run it themselves

steal_this: Offer a 'set up your company's private AI coworker' implementation package — install OpenBot, connect it to their tools, charge a setup fee plus a monthly support retainer.
